sloka: महोदरं तं विनिपात्य भूमौ महागिरेः कीर्णमिवैकदेशम्।सूर्यात्मजस्तत्र रराज लक्ष्म्या सूर्यः स्वतेजोभिरिवाप्रधृष्यः ।। ६.९८.३८ ।।
transliteration: mahodaraṁ taṁ vinipātya bhūmau mahāgireḥ kīrṇamivaikadeśam।sūryātmajastatra rarāja lakṣmyā sūryaḥ svatejobhirivāpradhṛṣyaḥ ।। 6.98.38 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva, the monkey leader having killed Mahodara, the Vanaras shouted in joy. The ten headed Ravana became enraged. Raghava was glad.
